subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Landing on the moon is undoubtedly an important event in the history of mankind. Before that, nobody thought that man could reach the moon. But Neil Armstrong with other two astronauts made this impossible thing possible. They started their journey to the moon on 16th July, 1969. The main spaceship used by them. was Apollo 11. It took four days to reach the moon.
